title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Quantum integrability for polynomial in momenta integrals
exact_target: Lift the argument-shift algebra of any finite-dimensional Lie algebra to an exactly commuting enveloping-algebra subalgebra, or find an obstruction.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100711 (AMR-020-0711). CC BY 4.0.

Alexey Bolsinov, Vladimir S. Matveev, Eva Miranda and Serge Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), Problem 7.12 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
